findings: Existing _gather_paper_metadata is the narrow cache-miss batching seam; existing parsing helpers and per-PMID files can be reused.
ELink id must be a list, not comma-joined; map LinkSet IdList and pubmed_pmc destinations by source PMID, never response position.
Valid no-link groups differ from absent, malformed or ambiguous groups; failures must remain incomplete per PMID.

Current legacy path caches usable metadata after failed ELink as pmc_full_text_id=None. Batch path must avoid persisting this incomplete lookup as successful absence. Legacy behavior remains unchanged.

Legacy runner demands ELink wrapper entries equal fresh metadata count and EFetch entries at least that count. Genuine batching needs separate prospective record-level proof, not weaker historical assertions.
Keep PMC full-text downloads, selected-paper logic and existing pagination intact. All transport stays on existing pacer; no new per-ID fallback or retry.
Per-ID trace context requires explicit expansion of batch failures and outcomes; aggregate batch counts alone cannot prove record completeness.
